body:
LASTING GREG RULES on evidence refusals and simple procedures. Kept live as standing rules, so they no longer retire with w-89f3b3eeb688; consolidated on 2026-11-11 by Engram::Fable after 11334's retirement check (mailbox 5674b8de #2306).

GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-04 about 07:50Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #219, message 621ea76f), after the source_moved_after_check result: „Hmm. Trzymajmy procedury jak prosto jak się da.” Asistant's relayed brief, not his verbatim words: agree with TermAl a simple automatic fix of the cause; no manual empty turns as a standing procedure; no weakening of evidence credibility; avoid needless steps in rolling out Execution Observability. (This was the full content of rules-greg-simple-procedures-2026-11-04, preserved here.)

GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-04 about 16:05Z, after both evaluation windows were refused, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #235, message b1f8d665): „To nie moze tak byc. Znowu bedziemy odrzucac poprawne testy.” Asistant's brief, not his words: with TermAl, establish the actual source of the refusals and fix the automatic distinction between correct evidence and a real source change. No silence, no empty turns, no weakening of protection. Prepare positive and negative regression cases and a simple end-to-end path with normal work, leave existing evaluations untouched, and work autonomously.

GREG DIRECT, about 16:06Z, verbatim via Asistant (43498a6e #238, message be5771e9): „Bez workaround i skomplikowanych procedur.” Asistant's brief: remove the cause in the product so the normal work cycle runs automatically. No temporary workarounds, empty turns, manual ordering or new agent procedures; keep protection against a real source change.

Standing reading: correct evidence must not be falsely rejected. The product, not agent procedure, must distinguish correct evidence from a real source change. Prefer the simplest automatic fix and keep evidence credible.
